duplicate_groups.notes: Single fee-vault dossier covers protocol-fee discounting and L1/DA fee recovery underpayment.
Lido delayed-loss, claimable-exit, and batch-cap variants cover stale provider-loss pricing.
Gas-refund finalizer and native-yield balance/share-count overhead jointly cover the broad native bookkeeping finding.
F57-002 is treated as a related stale-loss entrant sibling rather than a distinct final-report false positive.

false_positives.title: Proof-time ETH withdrawal requests can outlive invalidated output roots
Provider removal can drop nonzero provider principal or pending withdrawals from aggregate accounting
Insurance proxies are configured into yield managers without being upgraded or initialized
USDInsurance implementation is constructed with L1BlastBridgeProxy instead of USDYieldManagerProxy
Cannon global preimage updates are sent to the fault-game contract instead of the preimage oracle
Closing-frame pruning undercounts retained channel bytes and can bypass channel-bank memory pruning

found_findings.notes: Saved gas maturity survives full-balance claims and can attach to later gas.
found_findings.title: etherSeconds can be accrued to allow riskless DOS of the node

found_findings.notes: The scan identifies global refund scaling/socialization reducing other contracts' claimable gas, though it was downgraded as codified behavior.
found_findings.title: Users can steal gas fees back from developers due to imprecise refund mechanism

found_findings.notes: Direct ETH-yield deposits lack messenger retry/base-gas protection and can fail finalization.
found_findings.title: minGasLimit miscalculated for stETH deposits

found_findings.notes: Implementation-local initialization and malicious provider delegatecall path is exact; validation downgraded current-fork bricking.
found_findings.title: USD Yield Manager can be bricked by self destructing uninitialized implementation

found_findings.notes: Valid Blast native precompile selectors bypass intended RequiredGas.
found_findings.title: DoS due to Yield Precompile Always Charging 0 Gas

found_findings.notes: WETHRebasing genesis omits initializer postconditions including initial price.
found_findings.title: WETH will never rebase because initial share price/share count is zero

found_findings.notes: Discounted failed-relay sidecar writes can exceed inherited reserved gas and strand finalized withdrawals.
found_findings.title: Withdrawals/messages can be lost due to incorrect RELAY_RESERVED_GAS

found_findings.notes: SubClaimableAmount omits prevFlags and rollback can restore YieldAutomatic.
found_findings.title: Journal entry is missing flag parameter in SubClaimableAmount

found_findings.notes: Invalid/malformed precompile calls revert with zero native precompile gas.
found_findings.title: Blast precompile reverts cost zero gas

found_findings.notes: Output identifies address-keyed governor/gas/yield configuration outliving code identity across upgrade/redeploy lifecycles.
found_findings.title: CREATE2 deployments can have governor role stolen

found_findings.notes: Positive nominal discounted messages can round to zero and fail before messenger failure state is recorded.
found_findings.title: Withdrawals that include 1 wei can be bricked in negative rebase

found_findings.notes: Split/partial gas claims can preserve seconds and outperform one-shot claimAll.
found_findings.title: claimAll function may not claim gas at optimal rate

found_findings.notes: Protocol fee vaults can withdraw through the discounted ETH queue during negative yield.
found_findings.title: Protocol gas fees can be withdrawn at a discount in negative yield

found_findings.notes: Repeated high-frame precompile calls pay BlastGasParamStorageGas every time.
found_findings.title: BlastGasParamStorageGas should not be paid every time for precompile calls

found_findings.notes: Access-list warmth does not suppress the Blast high-frame surcharge.
found_findings.title: EIP-2930 access-list incompatibility with custom surcharge

found_findings.notes: No-code/EOA calls can repeatedly satisfy the first-use surcharge predicate.
found_findings.title: Calls charge additional gas even if target address is an EOA

found_findings.notes: Already-claimable Lido exits and batch-cap tails can remain valued at par before finalization.
found_findings.title: PendingBalance funds included in withdrawal sharePrice calculation

found_findings.notes: Constructor-only Blast/Gas predeploy proxy-intent mismatch was identified and downgraded as upgrade-safety debt.
found_findings.title: Non-upgradeable predeploys are deployed behind upgradeable proxies

found_findings.notes: Lido oracle-cap/delayed-loss window can let withdrawals finalize at par.
found_findings.title: Overpayment for withdrawals in slashing events exceeding oracle cap

found_findings.notes: L1 portal value uses raw amount while finalizer calldata uses WAD-converted amount.
found_findings.title: L1BlastBridge sends raw amount without converting to 18 decimals

found_findings.notes: L1/DA fee vault recovery can be underpaid by discounted remote withdrawals.
found_findings.title: Undercharging L1 data availability fees during discounted withdrawals

found_findings.notes: Access-list intrinsic gas is allocated to the Blast/global bucket rather than warmed dapps.
found_findings.title: Access lists attribute gas to Blast instead of smart contracts

found_findings.notes: GasTracker allocations survive reverted frames and can become claimable gas.
found_findings.title: Gas allocation mechanics on reverted transactions

found_findings.notes: Fresh stETH deposits during known loss can share later insurance repair.
found_findings.title: One-time insurance can be front-run by fresh stETH depositors

found_findings.notes: Maker DSR liveness and lack of alternate recovery are identified around DSR_MANAGER join/exit paths.
found_findings.title: All staked DAI can be lost if Maker initiates shutdown

found_findings.notes: Round 10 preserved both gas-refund finalizer overhead and native-yield balance/share-count overhead.
found_findings.title: Undercompensated gas for native yield and native gas refund features

found_findings.notes: Delegatecall/callcode surcharge predicate checks target identity while charging caller context.
found_findings.title: Custom gas penalty should not be applied to delegatecall/callcode

found_findings.notes: Nested reinitializer xDomainMsgSender reset double-delivery mechanism is identified, though validation marked current-code reachability invalid.
found_findings.title: Anyone can front-run upgrades to execute a double withdrawal
